scenes.say: Your shop is closed. Who answers?
scenes.title: Closed? Still answering.

scenes.say: I'm Vee, from VAgent. This is our voice receptionist.
scenes.title: Meet Vee

scenes.say: Hold the button and ask, in English or Arabic.
scenes.title: Ask in English or Arabic
chat: Do you have a chocolate cake?

scenes.say: It answers from your catalog and shows the product.
scenes.title: Answers from your catalog
chat: Yes. Here it is, from today's menu.

scenes.say: Want to hear it for your business? Send us a message.
scenes.title: Message us

caption: A voice receptionist that answers from your own catalog, in English or Arabic, and takes orders. Send us a message for a demo.
